name: Text Easability components
reference_corpus: CLEAR corpus (Crossley et al. 2022), CLEAR_corpus_final.csv, translated into German with Kolibri-1 Q4_K_M (translation_kolibri-1-q4km), 4669 of 4724 excerpts (without truncated translations and paragraph mismatches)
method: PCA on standardized inputs (missing values: reference mean), Varimax rotation; z = standardized inputs @ weights; percentile = share of reference texts with a lower z; at runtime only inputs with missing_documents > 0 may be missing (reference mean), otherwise the components are undefined

inputs.measure: Words before main verb of main clause
Dissimilarity of parts of speech between sentences
